name: settings_state
description: Read actual phone settings: stored brightness preference and automatic mode, auto-rotation, flashlight availability/state, airplane mode. Use for relative requests and verification.

name: settings_brightness
description: Set screen brightness without leaving the current app. percent is a manual brightness preference from 0 to 100 (0 uses minimum readable brightness), not measured luminance; it disables automatic brightness. Or enable automatic brightness alone. Read returned state.

name: settings_rotation
description: Enable or disable automatic screen rotation without leaving the current app. Repeated identical requests are idempotent.

name: settings_flashlight
description: Turn the rear flashlight on or off without leaving the current app. Reports actual torch callback state; may fail if another app owns the camera. Repeated identical requests are idempotent.

name: settings_open_panel
description: Open an Android settings panel and verify its foreground. This does NOT change a setting. Airplane mode has no direct tool control; use its panel and screen controls if requested. Read settings_state afterward to verify changes.
